summary.text: Darrell Odom is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 27A, appointed in January 2026, and is seeking election to a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election. He works in emergency medical services.

paragraphs.text: Odom served in the U.S. Army and the U.S. Coast Guard.
He earned an associate degree from Prince George's Community College and a bachelor's degree in fire science from the University of Maryland Global Campus.
His career experience includes serving with the Prince George's County fire and emergency medical services department.
Gov. Wes Moore appointed him to District 27A on January 12, 2026, to replace Kevin M. Harris, and he assumed office on January 13, 2026.
